notes: two isnads one after the other, with no «ح» and the same saying: two groups; the second repeats Yunus, so the tail is not shared (rule 3)
the first isnad ends at Yunus in the text; the names ابن شهاب، عروة، عائشة are written only in the second isnad
«قال يحيى بن سليمان» is the verb of the first isnad, not a name
